nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 state variable holding the liquidity asset token controlled by the FundingLocker.
Immutable address state variable storing the authorized Loan contract that may pull or drain funds.
Constructor of FundingLocker that sets the liquidityAsset and loan state variables.
isLoan modifier that enforces msg.sender == loan, providing access control on pull and drain.
External isLoan-guarded function that transfers a requested amount of liquidity asset to a destination address.
External isLoan-guarded function that transfers the entire liquidity asset balance held by the contract to the Loan.
Caller-controlled address used in the isLoan modifier comparison against the loan state variable.
External call to the liquidity asset token contract performed during safeTransfer, allowing arbitrary token code to execute.
SafeERC20 library function invoked by pull and drain that encodes and dispatches the token transfer call.
Low-level address(token).functionCall performed by _callOptionalReturn, transferring control to the token contract with all available gas.
Constructor parameter _liquidityAsset used to initialize the liquidityAsset state variable.
Constructor parameter _loan used to initialize the loan state variable.
pull function parameter dst, the destination address receiving the liquidity asset tokens.
pull function parameter amt, the amount of liquidity asset tokens to transfer.
Local variable amt in drain holding the contract's full liquidity asset balance before transferring it to the Loan.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside the isLoan modifier to authenticate the caller.
msg.sender is compared against the loan state variable, granting privileged access when equal.
pull is guarded by the isLoan modifier, which must pass before execution proceeds.
drain is guarded by the isLoan modifier, which must pass before execution proceeds.
pull invokes SafeERC20.safeTransfer on the liquidity asset token.
drain invokes SafeERC20.safeTransfer on the liquidity asset token.
safeTransfer hands control to the external token contract, enabling reentrancy before state settles.
The token external call is dispatched through the low-level address(token).functionCall, forwarding all gas to untrusted code.
Constructor parameter _liquidityAsset flows into the constructor execution.
Constructor parameter _loan flows into the constructor execution.
_liquidityAsset is assigned to the liquidityAsset state variable.
_loan is assigned to the loan state variable.
The dst parameter flows into pull's transfer logic.
The amt parameter flows into pull's transfer logic.
The local amt computed from the token balance flows into drain's transfer.
The dst parameter is forwarded to safeTransfer as the transfer recipient.
The amt parameter is forwarded to safeTransfer as the transfer amount.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only initializes the liquidityAsset state variable and should be merged into the constructor core function.
Constructor parameter only initializes the loan state variable and should be merged into the constructor core function.
Non-core parameter is only consumed by the pull function's transfer call and should be merged into pull.
Non-core parameter is only consumed by the pull function's transfer call and should be merged into pull.
Non-core local variable is derived from the token balance and only used by drain's transfer and should be merged into drain.
